headline: A 2022 law authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to the World War II Ghost Army units, the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops and the 3133rd Signal Services Company.
what_it_does: This law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to two World War II units, the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops and the 3133rd Signal Services Company, known together as the Ghost Army. The award recognizes what the law calls unique and highly distinguished service during the war. The official summary does not describe any money, benefits, or new rules beyond the medal itself.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on February 1, 2022.
